title: Global generation of an invertible sheaf of degree at least 2h^1 on every reduced connected closed subscheme of dimension 1 of a proper curve
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves a global generation criterion by degree (statement lines 5754-5765: deg(L|_Y) >= 2 dim H^1(Y, O_Y) for every reduced connected closed Y of dimension 1). The proof (lines 5767-5919 and its closing lines to 5960) is not a single reference: it combines a base-field replacement, a duality dimension count dim H^0(X, IL) = deg(L) + chi(O_X) > dim H^0(X, omega_X), a generic-point union-of-subspaces argument that needs k infinite, a factorization of every Hom(IL, omega_X) through the complement Y via omega_Y = SheafHom(O_Y, omega_X), and a final boundary-map injectivity contradiction with the induction hypothesis. H3: several independent non-formal ingredients are composed, and the reduction step to infinite fields is itself a real argument.
